Medium Affected: WATER

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 14 gallons
AT APPROXIMATELY 10:30 P.M. ON TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2008, CHELAN PUD EXPERIENCED A FOURTH HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK FROM THE FISH BYPASS SYSTEM (FBS) AT ROCKY REACH DAM. AN ESTIMATED 13.5 GALLONS WAS MISSING FROM THE HPU OIL RESERVOIR AND OIL WAS LOCATED IN THE NORTH SLOT OF UNIT C-2 AND THE NORTH SLIDE GATE WELL. AT 11:15 P.M., WASHINGTON DEPARTMENT OF ECOLOGY WAS NOTIFIED. OIL ABSORBENT PADS WERE PLACED WITHIN THE GATE WELL BUT VERY LITTLE OIL WAS RECOVERED. DIVERS WERE DISPATCHED AT 7:00 AM THE NEXT MORNING TO INVESTIGATE THE PROBLEM AND DISCOVERED A LOOSE HOSE FITTING IN THE UNIT TWO IS SYSTEM. CREWS TIGHTENED THE FITTING AND PLAN TO CONDUCT A DIVER INSPECTION OF UNIT ONE IS SYSTEM TO MAKE SURE NO ADDITIONAL LOOSE FITTINGS ARE IDENTIFIED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 1019389 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1019389
Incident Time: 2012-07-27 09:30:00
Nearest City: Baltimore, MD
Location: SOUTHWEST OF TANK 3 6000 PENNINGTON AVE
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: WATER
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.211447, -76.586900 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 1500 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** AT ~11:00 AM, WHILE DECANTING WATER FROM THE VAC TRUCK, THE BACK DOOR OF THE VAC TRUCK POPPED OPEN RELEASING ~1500 GALLONS OF LIGHT OIL SLUDGE/WATER MIXTURE. IT IS ESTIMATED THAT ~500 GALLONS WAS THE LIGHT OIL SOLIDS/SLUDGE FRACTION. THE TRUCK WAS LOCATED IN THE CONTAINMENT AREA OF OUR WEST TANK FARM. THE MAGNITUDE OF THE SPILL BREACHED THE DIKE AREA OF THE TANK 3 SUMP PIT. ~55 GALLONS OF THE MIXTURE WAS PUMPED AUTOMATICALLY TO OUR GRIT SEPARATOR. THE ONLY OTHER FLOW TO THE GRIT SEPARATOR AT THE TIME WAS THE STORM POND PUMP. THE GRIT SEPARATOR FLOWS TO THE OIL SEPARATOR WHICH FLOWS TO THE NORTH POND WHICH OVER FLOWS THROUGH THE POND VALVE TO THE PLANT NPDES DISCHARGE POINT. THE POND VALVE WAS CLOSED, THE STORM POND PUMP WAS TURNED OFF, ALL OTHER POTENTIAL SOURCES OF WATER (TANK 12/13 SUMP, TANK 7 SUMP AND TANK 11 SUMP) WERE TURNED OFF. THE DECANTING PROCESS INVOLVES CRACKING OPEN THE TRUCK'S BACK DOOR TO ALLOW THE WATER TO DECANT FROM THE SOLIDS/SLUDGES. THIS WAS SUCCESSFULLY DONE ALL DAY YESTERDAY, BUT THE DOOR WAS OPENED ENOUGH THAT THE BARS THAT HOLD THE DOOR SHUT SLIPPED OFF SEAT AND THE DOOR FULLY OPENED. THE LIGHT OIL SOLIDS/SLUDGES WERE FROM CLEANING OUT OUR KNOCK OUT POT AND CYCLONE SEPARATOR. GASES OFF OUR TANKS, AND V3 & V4 OXIDIZERS FLOW THRU THE KNOCK OUT AND CUYCLONE SEPARATOR TO COLLECT ANY CONDENSABLES AND SOLIDS BEFORE THE GASES GO TO THE AFTER BURNER TO BE INCINERATED. THIS WAS THE SECOND DAY OF SEMI-ANNUAL CLEAN OUT OF THESE VESSELS BY S&G ENVIRONMENTAL. THE VAC TRUCK WAS RENTED BY S&G FROM VEOLIA ENVIRONMENTAL.
